Copy trading has grown into a mainstream way for both beginners and seasoned investors to participate in the markets without needing to analyze every chart themselves. In this **copy trading platforms review 2026**, we look at the leading services, what they offer, and how you can pick the right one for your goals. Whether you’re after low fees, diverse strategy providers, or advanced risk‑management tools, the platforms covered here represent the current state of the art.

## How Copy Trading Works  

At its core, copy trading lets you automatically mirror the trades of another trader, known as a signal provider or strategy manager. When the provider opens, modifies, or closes a position, your account executes the same action in proportion to the amount you’ve allocated. Most platforms handle the synchronization in real time, so you don’t need to place orders manually. You retain control over how much capital to assign, can stop copying at any time, and often set stop‑loss or take‑profit limits to manage risk. This model bridges the gap between passive investing and active trading, giving you exposure to expert strategies while you learn.

## Top Copy Trading Platforms in 2026  

### eToro Review  

eToro remains a household name, offering a social‑trading feed where you can browse thousands of traders, view their performance stats, and copy with a single click. The platform supports stocks, ETFs, crypto, and CFDs, with copy trading fees built into the spread. In 2026, eToro introduced a “Risk Score” overlay that helps you gauge volatility before allocating funds. Minimum copy amount is $200, making it accessible for most retail users.

### ZuluTrade Review  

ZuluTrade focuses exclusively on forex and CFDs, providing a robust ranking system based on Sharpe ratio, drawdown, and win‑rate. Its “ZuluGuard” feature automatically stops copying a provider if their risk exceeds a preset threshold. The platform offers a free tier with limited providers and a premium subscription that unlocks advanced analytics and lower commission tiers. For 2026, ZuluTrade added a mobile‑first UI that simplifies strategy discovery on the go.
